substantive_change: Coupled cross-layer compute debit/credit with a downstream signed action target; later spatial mixing would be a separately defined native action geometry, not more q, rank, banks or router width.
why_old_obstruction_does_not_decide_this: The old same-width action set cannot express redistributing54 whole groups between two layers; native R7 establishes that downstream rankings and block31 states change causally. This motivates testing a distinct operator, but does not establish positive R12 headroom: the missing opposite-layer debit term can reverse every old gain. No immunity from old failures is claimed.
falsifiable_prediction: True equal-budget native action winners vary by source AND the offline oracle beats the strongest matched fixed member and frozen UB1 by the precommitted diagnostic margin. Opposing prediction: one fixed member dominates or extra conditional gain is negligible.
cheapest_decisive_test: Independently review/register the D0 native-value draft, then run controls before the fixed three-action matrix. No predictor training before actual action headroom. A D0 failure closes only its raw/no-correction instance; no post-hoc width/support/source/pair sweep.
